tokens.name: openui-background
tokens.usage: App canvas behind everything: the page itself. Light is a soft off-white so white cards read as raised.

tokens.name: openui-foreground
tokens.usage: Raised surface: cards, panels, the chat composer, radio and switch knobs. Despite the name this is a SURFACE, never a text color.

tokens.name: openui-popover-background
tokens.usage: Menus, select lists, popovers and modal sheets.

tokens.name: openui-sunk-light
tokens.usage: Faintest recessed fill. Translucent ink, so it tints whatever surface it sits on.

tokens.name: openui-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed fill: tab rails, neutral tags, disabled inputs, the unchecked switch track, sunk cards.

tokens.name: openui-sunk-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest recessed fill, for a well inside a sunk area.

tokens.name: openui-elevated-light
tokens.usage: Faint stacked fill above a surface.

tokens.name: openui-elevated
tokens.usage: Stacked fill above a surface: the active tab pill, skeleton bars.

tokens.name: openui-elevated-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger stacked fill: skeleton chart shapes, pressed chips.

tokens.name: openui-elevated-intense
tokens.usage: Heaviest stacked fill; use sparingly for scrubbers and progress tracks.

tokens.name: openui-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and drawers.

tokens.name: openui-highlight-subtle
tokens.usage: Resting fill of inputs, textareas and select triggers; zebra rows in tables.

tokens.name: openui-highlight
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed wash for secondary and tertiary buttons, select trigger hover.

tokens.name: openui-highlight-strong
tokens.usage: Selected row or item wash.

tokens.name: openui-highlight-intense
tokens.usage: Strongest wash; drag targets and active scrub regions.

tokens.name: openui-inverted-background
tokens.usage: Ink-colored ground for inverted chips and tooltips; pair with text-accent-primary in light.

tokens.name: openui-info-background
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for info tags and badges; pair with text-info-primary.

tokens.name: openui-success-background
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for success tags and badges; pair with text-success-primary.

tokens.name: openui-alert-background
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for warning tags and badges; pair with text-alert-primary.

tokens.name: openui-danger-background
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for danger tags and badges; pair with text-danger-primary.

tokens.name: openui-purple-background
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for purple tags and badges; pair with text-purple-primary.

tokens.name: openui-pink-background
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for pink tags and badges; pair with text-pink-primary.

tokens.name: openui-chat-user-response-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the user's own message bubble in chat layouts.

tokens.name: openui-chat-user-response-text
tokens.usage: Text inside the user's message bubble.

tokens.name: openui-text-neutral-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings and labels on background, foreground and popover-background.

tokens.name: openui-text-neutral-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: table headers, hints, placeholders, descriptions. 60% ink holds 4.5:1 on background and foreground in both themes.

tokens.name: openui-text-neutral-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons only. 20% ink sits far below 4.5:1 by design; never use it for content people must read.

tokens.name: openui-text-neutral-link
tokens.usage: Inline links. Neutral ink, so always underline them.

tokens.name: openui-text-brand
tokens.usage: Brand blue text for a highlighted keyword or an active nav item on light surfaces. In dark it reads below 4.5:1 on background (source value kept); reserve it for 24px+ or use text-info-primary there.

tokens.name: openui-text-white
tokens.usage: Fixed white, theme-independent: text on photos or on fixed dark fills.

tokens.name: openui-text-black
tokens.usage: Fixed black, theme-independent: text on fixed light fills.

tokens.name: openui-text-accent-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on interactive-accent fills: primary buttons, checked checkboxes.

tokens.name: openui-text-accent-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on accent fills (a button's helper count).

tokens.name: openui-text-accent-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled text on accent fills.

tokens.name: openui-text-success-primary
tokens.usage: Success text on success-background and on page surfaces (tag labels, callout titles).

tokens.name: openui-text-success-inverted
tokens.usage: Text on a solid success fill.

tokens.name: openui-text-alert-primary
tokens.usage: Warning text on alert-background and on page surfaces (tag labels, callout titles).

tokens.name: openui-text-alert-inverted
tokens.usage: Text on a solid warning fill.

tokens.name: openui-text-danger-primary
tokens.usage: Danger text on danger-background and on page surfaces (tag labels, callout titles, error hints).

tokens.name: openui-text-danger-secondary
tokens.usage: Softer danger text: secondary error lines.

tokens.name: openui-text-danger-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled danger text (disabled destructive buttons).

tokens.name: openui-text-danger-inverted-primary
tokens.usage: Text on the solid destructive fill (interactive-destructive-accent-default).

tokens.name: openui-text-danger-inverted-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the solid destructive fill.

tokens.name: openui-text-danger-inverted-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled text on the solid destructive fill.

tokens.name: openui-text-info-primary
tokens.usage: Info text on info-background and on page surfaces (tag labels, callout titles).

tokens.name: openui-text-info-inverted
tokens.usage: Text on a solid info fill.

tokens.name: openui-text-pink-primary
tokens.usage: Pink text on pink-background and on page surfaces (tag labels, callout titles).

tokens.name: openui-text-pink-inverted
tokens.usage: Text on a solid pink fill.

tokens.name: openui-text-purple-primary
tokens.usage: Purple text on purple-background and on page surfaces (tag labels, callout titles).

tokens.name: openui-text-purple-inverted
tokens.usage: Text on a solid purple fill.

tokens.name: openui-interactive-accent-default
tokens.usage: Primary action fill: primary buttons, checked checkbox, radio dot, switch track on. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: openui-interactive-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary fill on hover (80% of the accent).

tokens.name: openui-interactive-accent-disabled
tokens.usage: Primary fill when disabled (40% of the accent).

tokens.name: openui-interactive-accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary fill while pressed.

tokens.name: openui-interactive-destructive-default
tokens.usage: Faint red wash at rest for secondary destructive buttons.

tokens.name: openui-interactive-destructive-hover
tokens.usage: Red wash on hover for secondary and tertiary destructive buttons.

tokens.name: openui-interactive-destructive-disabled
tokens.usage: Red wash when a destructive button is disabled.

tokens.name: openui-interactive-destructive-pressed
tokens.usage: Red wash while a destructive button is pressed.

tokens.name: openui-interactive-destructive-accent-default
tokens.usage: Solid fill of the primary destructive button (Delete, Remove).

tokens.name: openui-interactive-destructive-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Solid destructive fill on hover.

tokens.name: openui-interactive-destructive-accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Solid destructive fill while pressed.

tokens.name: openui-interactive-destructive-accent-disabled
tokens.usage: Solid destructive fill when disabled.

tokens.name: openui-border-default
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card and table outlines, row dividers, separators, and the 2.5px focus halo around inputs.

tokens.name: openui-border-interactive
tokens.usage: Outline of controls at rest: inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes, unchecked radios. About 1.3:1 on surfaces, under the 3:1 control-border floor (source value kept); controls also carry a fill or label so they stay findable.

tokens.name: openui-border-interactive-emphasis
tokens.usage: Border of a focused input or textarea.

tokens.name: openui-border-interactive-selected
tokens.usage: Full-ink border for a selected option and the neutral callout rule.

tokens.name: openui-border-accent
tokens.usage: Edge on accent-filled controls (primary button, checked radio ring).

tokens.name: openui-border-accent-emphasis
tokens.usage: Stronger accent edge for a selected accent card.

tokens.name: openui-border-info
tokens.usage: Info hairline; also the 2.5px halo on a info field.

tokens.name: openui-border-info-emphasis
tokens.usage: Solid info rule: the callout's left edge.

tokens.name: openui-border-alert
tokens.usage: Warning hairline; also the 2.5px halo on a warning field.

tokens.name: openui-border-alert-emphasis
tokens.usage: Solid warning rule: the callout's left edge.

tokens.name: openui-border-success
tokens.usage: Success hairline; also the 2.5px halo on a success field.

tokens.name: openui-border-success-emphasis
tokens.usage: Solid success rule: the callout's left edge.

tokens.name: openui-border-danger
tokens.usage: Danger hairline; also the 2.5px halo on an input in error.

tokens.name: openui-border-danger-emphasis
tokens.usage: Solid danger rule: the callout's left edge, the border of an input in error.
